title: PictFlash Don Don
native_title: ピクトフラッシュ どんどん
overview:
A plaything that stimulates the brain while building concentration and a sense for language. Give your head a fun workout with the whole family.

PictFlash Don Don is educational software for young children aged 1 to 6. Picture cards flash up on the screen one after another, such as animals, fruit and flowers, so children can play along while picking up words in Japanese, English and Chinese.

頭脳を活性化しながら集中力や言語感覚を育てる遊び道具です。ご家族みんなで、楽しく頭の体操をしてください。
